<quote by="Announced by Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, Master of Rings">To construct "Lumi's Legacy". Being a herb sinecure, located in East Floes, Sermerusaq, with the intent to focus on bladeroot cultivation. The title of Legal Leaseholder of Lumi's Legacy is to have tenure and be elected by unanimous pick of the Wintermark senators.
